megajs 1.3.10 (npm megajs, MIT, https://mega.js.org), MEGA's open-source JavaScript SDK:
dist/main.browser-umd.js copied as megajs.browser.js. It sets window.mega. The phone
app loads it the first time the MEGA tools or Settings > MEGA cloud need it
(agent-ui/mega-cloud.js). Bundled libraries keep their licence notes at the end of the file.
